task_title: Fix edge-blend-sessions exact preselection input failed
notes: Harness-only fix; no production file changed. Root cause proven to be locale, not geometry or timing: the session shell is LANG=nl_NL.UTF-8 LC_NUMERIC=nl_NL.UTF-8 where the decimal separator is a comma and the point is the group separator, so QLocale().toDouble(1.23456789) returns 0 and the QDoubleValidator that PullDimensionValidator installs (src/CadViewport.cpp:110) rejects the string, making CadViewport::updateCommandParameter (src/CadViewport.cpp:389) return false and previewEdgeBlend never run. Decisive differential: the same unmodified binary exits 0 under LC_ALL=C LANG=C and exits 1 in the session locale. In-test diagnostic printed locale=nl_NL text=1.23456789 toDouble_ok=0 hasAcceptable=0 valid=0 value=0 geomErr=Enter a finite positive value in millimeters. with the positive control localeText=1,23456789 giving toDouble_ok=1 hasAcceptable=1 valid=1; the diagnostic was fully reverted (md5 10e838c547e8ab3fd153a18402638b43 matches the pre-task backup, zero DIAG markers remain). The 300 ms planar numeric debounce from Phases 4 to 8 was ruled out by reading src/CadViewport.cpp:268, which returns false unless moveFeature_ is Planar, so a Fillet session is synchronous and awaiting would be wrong. The 2-decimal precision gate was ruled out by src/CadViewport.cpp:307 which already raises decimals to 17 for Fillet and Chamfer, and by a standalone Qt 6.11.2 probe at /tmp/pr79p9/qprobe/probe.cpp separating the two gates under both locales. Fix: five hardcoded decimal literals replaced with QLocale().toString(value,'f',N), the idiom already used six times in the same file at lines 247 252 298 523 606 656; sites are tests/EdgeBlendSessionTest.cpp lines 402 411 427 434 471. Integer literals were left untouched because they are locale-invariant. No assertion, message, tolerance, timeout or geometry changed. Results: pre-fix repro exit 1; post-fix direct runs 3 of 3 exit 0 in the session locale plus 1 of 1 exit 0 under LC_ALL=C; ctest single test #133 edge-blend-sessions 3 PASS 0 FAIL in 4.22 4.14 4.19 s; full 52-name OpenDesignerSelectionContextTests family 52 PASS 0 FAIL in 146.81 s of test time, closing the family that the save-prompt task left at 51 PASS 1 FAIL. build_seconds is the sum of the three timed incremental builds (5.407 diagnostic + 5.318 fix + 5.377 final). test_seconds is the sum of the timed test commands (pre-fix repro 3.702 + four direct runs 4.115 each + three ctest singles 4.216 4.136 4.186 + family 146.81).
